notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional attribute Time Regulation re-enable surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies a queued regional update across Time Regulation disable/re-enable with changed lookahead, Query Lookahead, source-region metadata, reflection-before-grant ordering, Request Retraction, and cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.
